computational_witness.role: Constructed support witness and exact-case background; not a native T.thermophilus protein or experimental record.
computational_witness.construction: Keep coordinate anchor symbols where supported; replace its two forbidden states by the first allowed amino-acid symbol in canonical alphabet order.

restriction_data.split_semantics: Frozen restriction-input split for future computational planner tuning; not assay-label or sequence-training holdout. Evaluation inputs must not tune the planner.
